svg.text: Simulated devices — the LASER TARGET DESIGNATOR through the virtual panel (SD-S5c + SD-S5v, DESIGN_Simulated_Devices §3.13d / §3.13e)
Full colour = SPECIFIED · grey dashed + 'unchanged' = CONTEXT · the scene is illustrative · the chips are CLICKABLE (D-122) and carry their hotkey (D-124).
specified HUD element (dark halo) — chips carry their hotkey in a key box
the station adapter's hover frame (station-local, D-123)
Frames are 640 × 360, the view bound to the designator. POINT is the default: the cursor is free; hold RMB to LOOK. Layout positions are PROPOSALS.
16 · STANDBY — a target received from the linked rangefinder; the cursor on CODE (POINT)
Scope: window, reticle, STATE, CODE, the received-target cue, RANGE, the chip row with hotkeys, the hover frame and
the cursor. Compass and unit lines are context.
STATE STANDBY (green) · CODE 1688 (gold) · the cue: an amber arrow at the window's edge toward the
received point, its bearing offset and range, and who sent it · RANGE '— m' · the chips POWER P · LASE L ·
CODE C · RANGE R (each a PanelButton) · the gold hover frame on CODE and the hand cursor (the
A click on CODE steps the code (STANDBY only, D-113) — exactly the press its hotkey C, a pad button or a replica button
PROPOSAL: the cue at the window's left edge pointing toward the target; the chip row bottom-right; the LOOK hint
17 · LASING — the lase timer running, the view turned with RMB held (LOOK)
Scope: the LASE lamp lit, the reticle red, STATE LASING, the lase timer, the range to the spot, LASE lit; LOOK active
— the cursor hidden, the hint gold.
RMB held — the cursor is captured
LASE lamp lit (blinks by frame count) · the reticle red while lasing · STATE LASING (red) · the lase
timer bar: 42 s left of 60 (D-113) · RANGE 1 240 m (gold) · LASE chip lit · CODE greyed (steps only in
STANDBY) · LOOK active: no cursor, the hint gold
compass · unit lines · the scene (the spot on the tank is the 3-D map's laser layer — SD-S6)
The bomb's seeker sees this spot only while it is not a Preview (D-115) and only on its own code (D-117).
PROPOSAL: the timer under CODE; the 'captured' note is for this picture only, not drawn by the app.
18 · COOLING — the duty limit reached; LASE refused until it cools
Scope: STATE COOLING, the cool-down bar, LASE greyed, the cursor over LASE with the hover frame (a click does
STATE COOLING (amber) · the cool-down bar (19 s of 30) · LASE and CODE greyed (disabled
PanelButtons: hover frames them, a click presses nothing) · the last range kept
Disabled is the DEVICE's state drawn on the chip (D-122); the adapter does not decide it — a hotkey L is refused the same
PROPOSAL: a disabled chip still takes the hover frame, so the trainee sees why nothing happens.
19 · PAUSED — LASE clicked in a pause: queued for the first live frame
Scope: the same HUD in pause, STANDBY, the LASE chip lit with 'queued', no spot. The toolbar's paused state is context.
LASE pressed in pause: the chip lit with 'queued' (no designation in pause — R-4300 / D-115) · the lamp off
and no spot until time runs · POINT and LOOK still work (D-129)
the toolbar's run controls (paused) · compass · unit lines · the scene
Judged by dv-ltd-procedure: no non-Preview spot during the pause; the queued lase starts on the first live frame.
PROPOSAL: the 'queued' tag above the chip (the drone OSD's queued command, panel 15, says it the same way).
